skill_name: Suggest an online course suitable for a middle school student with an interest in web design.
workflow: Web design is a creative field that can be a great fit for middle school students. An online course that can be a great starting point for these students is Codecademy's 'Learn HTML & CSS.' The course is designed for beginners and provides an intuitive, step-by-step approach to learning the fundamentals of HTML and CSS. It also gives an introduction to popular web design frameworks like Bootstrap and Foundation, and provides a range of interactive tutorials and practices. The course is self-pace
